bssd: Bayesian Safety Signal Detection for Blinded Clinical Trial Data

Source: R/bssd-package.R
bssd-package.Rd

The package computes the posterior probability of a safety signal from blinded clinical trial data with the models examined by Duncan (2026): the BDRIBS model of Mukhopadhyay et al. (2018) with the total exposure time or the total time at risk (bdribs_post), the exponential Bernoulli mixture model (expbern_post), and the log-logistic Bernoulli mixture model (llbern_post). All posterior quantities are obtained by numerical integration, so no Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling is needed.

References

Duncan, B. (2026). Robust safety monitoring and signal detection using alternatives to the standard Poisson distribution. Journal of Biopharmaceutical Statistics, 36(2), 227–244. doi:10.1080/10543406.2024.2395532

Mukhopadhyay, S., Waterhouse, B., and Hartford, A. (2018). Bayesian detection of potential risk using inference on blinded safety data. Pharmaceutical Statistics, 17(6), 823–834. doi:10.1002/pst.1898
